name: How do I choose a reputable home improvement contractor?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose a reputable home improvement contractor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing a reputable contractor involves several key steps. Look for contractors with proper licensing, insurance, and a strong portfolio of completed projects. Request and check references from previous clients to assess their experience and reliability. Obtain detailed written estimates from multiple contractors to compare costs and scopes of work. A good contractor will communicate clearly, answer your questions thoroughly, and provide a transparent contract. Affordable Home Remodeling recommends verifying credentials and reviewing past work before making a decision.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a reputable contractor by checking licenses, insurance, references, and reviewing their portfolio. Get detailed written estimates and ensure clear communication.
